high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the news website "Firstpost." The article discusses Qatar's role as a trusted mediator in Afghanistan following the withdrawal of US forces. The text highlights Qatar's involvement in helping to evacuate thousands of foreigners and Afghans, engaging with the new Taliban rulers, and supporting operations at Kabul airport. Specifically, the article mentions that Qatar Airways planes have made several trips to Kabul, flying in aid and Doha's representatives while ferrying out foreign passport holders.
